subject: DPIA support & subprocessor transfer assurances for APAC deployment
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@greenriverhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPIA support + subprocessor assurances for APAC pilot

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from GreenRiver Health — we're moving forward with an APAC pilot for the Redwood inference integration and our privacy team needs a short package to close our DPIA and legal review. Specifically they asked for: 1) a short DPIA summary showing residual risk/mitigation for the pilot scope; 2) the current list of subprocessors with locations and whether data is routed outside of APAC; 3) confirmation of transfer mechanisms (SCCs/UK addendum or local adequacy); and 4) a small sample of processing logs or ledger entries (redacted) for audit.

Can you provide those items or point us to the right place? We're preparing a board packet and would love to have this by next Friday 16 April if possible.

Thanks,
Emma Lopez
Head of Privacy & Compliance
GreenRiver Health

Attachment: dpia_request_greenriver_20270407.eml (request form)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Lopez <emma@greenriverhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA support + subprocessor assurances for APAC pilot

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa from Customer Success to help coordinate and Jasmine (Legal) for the transfer/SCC confirmation. We can compile a short DPIA summary and provide an excerpt of the Art.30 register plus a sample of access logs (redacted).

Next steps:
- I'll assemble the DPIA summary and subprocessor list (with locations) and share an excerpt of our Art.30 register.
- Marissa will coordinate secure delivery for logs (S3 pre-signed or secure Drive link) and confirm what scope you need redacted.
- Jasmine will confirm which transfer mechanisms apply for your APAC pilot and whether Private deployment is a good option to avoid cross-border transfers.

Target: 2027-04-15 for the package (aiming to beat your Friday deadline). If anything is urgent before then we'll escalate.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-08T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPIA support + subprocessor assurances (GreenRiver) — ask/pack contents

Team — forwarding GreenRiver's request. Items to prepare:
1) DPIA one-pager (scope: inference logs + embeddings for pilot) — include residual risk and mitigations (KV caching, retention, encryption at rest/in transit).
2) Subprocessor inventory (current as of 2027-04-01) with country/region and role (hosting, observability, monitoring). Flag any processors with EU/US cross-border flows.
3) Art.30 register excerpt (processing categories + legal basis) — PDF excerpt fine.
4) Sample of access logs/ledger (CSV) — redact PII; show event types and timestamps.
5) Transfer mechanism summary (SCCs, UK addendum, adequacy) and an option note on Private deployment in APAC to keep data within region.

Marissa — can you arrange a secure share and confirm whether GreenRiver will accept redacted CSVs? Jasmine — any special language on SCCs / Addendum you'd like included in the package?

Thanks — Jonas
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-09T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPIA support + subprocessor assurances (GreenRiver) — legal inputs

Quick notes from Legal:
- Subprocessors: attach the current certified subprocessor list (we maintain third-party roles and country). For APAC routing the typical flows are: model inference hosted in us-west-2 (unless a Private/APAC deployment is selected) + logging/observability services in eu-central-1 for EU customers. For GreenRiver we should call out that hosted by default may route to US/EU.
- Transfers: SCCs are in place for EU->US flows (standard EU SCCs + UK Addendum where applicable). For APAC-specific countries we need to check local adequacy; for Australia/New Zealand we may rely on adequacy in practice but will provide SCCs where transfers are to/from non-adequate jurisdictions.
- DPIA summary: keep high-level, call out mitigations — encryption, KMS region (primary keys in eu-west-1 for EU accounts; default us-west-2 otherwise), role-based access controls, and our audit log retention policy (90 days standard; extended by contract).
- Audits: we can provide a small redacted access_log CSV sample and an excerpt from the Art.30 register. If GreenRiver requires a deeper audit (on-site or SOC2 evidence beyond our public SOC2 report) we'll need to funnel via sales/enterprise procurement.

I'll draft the SCC/transfer language and include a note offering Private deployment in APAC if they prefer zero cross-border processing.

Attachments: subprocessor_list_redwood_202704.pdf, art30_register_excerpt.pdf, dpia_summary_redwood_v1.docx

— Jasmine
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Lopez <emma@greenriverhealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@greenriverhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-10T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA support + subprocessor transfer assurances for APAC pilot — package attached

Emma / Oliver — please find the initial package attached and summarized below. Happy to walk through live if helpful.

What we provided (attachments and summary):
- DPIA summary (detailed scope: inference requests + ephemeral KV cache; mitigation summary) — dpia_summary_redwood_v1.docx.
- Subprocessor inventory: subprocessor_list_redwood_202704.pdf (lists hosting, monitoring, analytics vendors + countries).
- Art.30 register excerpt: art30_register_excerpt.pdf (processing categories and legal bases for pilot scope).
- Redacted access log sample: access_logs_sample.csv (events, no PII).

Transfer mechanisms and options:
- Default hosted mode: data may transit US/EU depending on model/runtime allocation. Transfers are covered by standard EU SCCs for EU-controlled data and the UK Addendum where applicable.
- APAC option: we can provision a Private deployment in a regional VPC (APAC region) to keep processing and keys within APAC — this avoids exporting event logs outside the region. This is a paid deployment option; Marissa can share pricing/lead time.

KMS / key locality: default key regions are shown in the DPIA summary. For APAC pilot we can request KMS keys in ap-southeast-1 to keep encryption keys in-region.

Next steps asked of GreenRiver:
1) Confirm whether the redacted CSV sample is adequate for your audit.
2) If you need SCCs executed or a formal DPA addendum signed, we'll route to Sales/Legal (HubSpot HS-35472).
3) Let us know if you prefer to pursue Private/APAC deployment — Marissa will follow up with a short options/pricing note.

If any of the artifacts need additional redaction or more context, tell us and we'll iterate quickly.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: dpia_summary_redwood_v1.docx, subprocessor_list_redwood_202704.pdf, art30_register_excerpt.pdf, access_logs_sample.csv
